scope: Ten exact-v1 deep routes; Method, evaluation, limitations and article-linked artifact boundary read from archived arXiv HTML.

reviews.claim: Inference-time reliability is partly owned by an explicit control layer that separates task framing, context selection, reasoning procedure, output constraints, memory reactivation and model routing from the pretrained model.
reviews.mechanism: CogniConsole decomposes control into a programmatic console, task cartridges and bounded decision-ladder nodes; hard control is kept outside fuzzy generation and state is selectively reactivated rather than replayed wholesale.
reviews.artifact_boundary: The article links https://github.com/Cogniconsole/cogniconsole but does not pin an event-time commit; the repository is not used to support v1 mechanism or benchmark claims.
reviews.proved: Within 489 controllability probes, additional external structure can change reliability independently of model weights.
reviews.not_proved: The probes do not establish that this decomposition is optimal, production-safe, or portable across all models, tasks and long-running state stores.
reviews.trade_off: Explicit control improves attribution and composability but creates more orchestration state, interface design, policy enforcement and recovery obligations.

reviews.claim: Expert swap pressure can be reduced at training time by making routing temporally sticky, not only at serving time through caches or placement heuristics.
reviews.mechanism: A differentiable consistency loss penalizes abrupt top-k expert changes between adjacent semantically coherent tokens; no expert architecture change is required, but the learned router now carries an inference-locality objective.
reviews.artifact_boundary: The article links https://github.com/alikayyam/sticky_moe.git without an event-time commit; code is not used as exact-v1 evidence.
reviews.proved: The reported models show that router-switch regularization can improve expert locality while retaining the evaluated quality envelope.
reviews.not_proved: The paper does not establish the same benefit for large production MoEs, arbitrary tokenization, expert-parallel clusters, or workloads whose optimal experts change rapidly.
reviews.trade_off: Locality reduces weight movement but constrains conditional capacity and adds a training hyperparameter; excessive stickiness may keep tokens on a suboptimal expert.

reviews.claim: Distributed MoE placement must become a predictive online control loop when expert demand changes faster than historical placement can adapt.
reviews.mechanism: A reconfiguration manager predicts routing from queued requests; a relaxation-based optimizer computes a bounded placement; live migration overlaps expert movement with compute and limits downtime.
reviews.artifact_boundary: The article cites EPLB as related software but does not publish a pinned Director implementation; cited repositories are not Director provenance.
reviews.proved: The prototype and approximation analysis support proactive placement under the paper's predicted-routing and migration model.
reviews.not_proved: It does not prove robustness to adversarial prediction error, heterogeneous failure domains, cross-cluster migration, or production tail-SLO behavior.
reviews.trade_off: Proactivity reduces expected communication imbalance but adds prediction error, optimization delay, migration bandwidth, placement-version state and rollback requirements.

reviews.claim: Moderate unstructured sparsity needs a storage and kernel design distinct from both dense GEMM and very-high-sparsity SpMM.
reviews.mechanism: A three-layer format combines Sparse Tensor Core-compatible regions, slot filling for surplus nonzeros and a residual path; the kernel pipelines metadata, sparse operands and residual work for memory-bound decode.
reviews.artifact_boundary: No author implementation is pinned in exact v1.
reviews.proved: The evaluated format/kernel can beat compared sparse and dense paths around the paper's moderate-sparsity, small-N decode region.
reviews.not_proved: It is slower than cuBLAS in compute-bound large-N prefill and does not beat the cited high-sparsity design in its native regime.
reviews.trade_off: The method gains decode throughput by paying format complexity, padding, residual bookkeeping and dependence on sparse Tensor Cores/HBM behavior.

reviews.claim: A frozen generative robot policy can be adapted from sparse human interventions by learning in its latent noise space instead of updating the base policy weights.
reviews.mechanism: Action inversion maps corrective actions to the latent noise that would generate them; a small noise policy learns those targets and steers the frozen flow/diffusion policy, including world-action models without a separate action head.
reviews.artifact_boundary: No event-time implementation commit is pinned in exact v1.
reviews.proved: The paper evaluates sample/compute-efficient correction on simulation and real manipulation within the support of the tested base policies.
reviews.not_proved: Latent steering cannot create behavior outside the pretrained action manifold and depends on the coverage and consistency of human interventions.
reviews.trade_off: Freezing weights limits catastrophic drift and training cost, but caps adaptation expressivity and inherits conditioning errors from inversion.

reviews.claim: Low-dimensional refusal representations are an attack surface: directly optimizing internal refusal directions can jailbreak models more efficiently than output-only objectives.
reviews.mechanism: Activation-Guided GCG suppresses refusal across layers/positions; Soft-GCG relaxes discrete suffix search into continuous optimization before discretization.
reviews.artifact_boundary: No event-time attack implementation is pinned in exact v1.
reviews.proved: Under white-box access and the evaluated models, representation-targeted objectives expose refusal fragility and reduce attack cost.
reviews.not_proved: The result does not imply all alignment is one linear direction, transfer to closed models, or that the reported attack succeeds under production defenses.
reviews.trade_off: Representation-level defenses require broader monitoring and adversarial testing, while publishing efficient attacks increases dual-use exposure.

reviews.claim: Recovery interventions change the behavior policy and must be excluded or corrected in the main policy gradient; treating mixed-policy transitions as on-policy silently biases learning.
reviews.mechanism: SafeExplorer masks recovery transitions from the policy gradient, relates mixed-policy training return to deployment return, substitutes an analytic recovery value under deterministic assumptions and imitates recovery only after successful segments.
reviews.artifact_boundary: The article cites MuJoCo assets but does not pin a SafeExplorer implementation; dependency repositories are not method provenance.
reviews.proved: The evaluated locomotion environments support fewer training falls for the proposed intervention-aware update in the reported regimes.
reviews.not_proved: The analytic value is exact only under deterministic dynamics/recovery; the observable safety certificate and general physical-robot transfer remain open.
reviews.trade_off: A permanent fallback lowers damage risk but changes data ownership, requires a safe-region contract and can cap exploration or imitate recovery errors.

reviews.claim: Diffusion language models need block-denoise scheduling and mixed-state execution rather than assuming every batched sequence advances one autoregressive token at a time.
reviews.mechanism: Completed requests are evicted at block boundaries, heterogeneous denoising states are gathered into one dense layout, and token-budget admission refills capacity.
reviews.artifact_boundary: No event-time implementation commit is pinned in exact v1.
reviews.proved: The paper reports throughput and capacity gains for two diffusion LMs under offline batching on one H200 while retaining its measured generation-quality envelope.
reviews.not_proved: Online arrivals, production tail latency, fairness and multi-GPU behavior are explicitly outside the evaluation.
reviews.trade_off: Smaller blocks reclaim slots sooner but add scheduling/denoising overhead; mixed-state metadata and approximate parallel decoding enlarge correctness and quality risk.

reviews.claim: Agent capability is a property of model plus harness; task-shared reasoning can sometimes be moved into instructions, tools and orchestration so a smaller model remains viable.
reviews.mechanism: A meta-agent diagnoses failure categories and searches harness adaptations instead of merely swapping the model inside a frontier-model scaffold.
reviews.artifact_boundary: The article links https://github.com/malusamayo/migration-analysis without an event-time commit; the repository is not treated as exact-v1 benchmark provenance.
reviews.proved: For seven curated business task families, harness adaptation can materially change the cost/performance frontier of smaller models.
reviews.not_proved: The headline cost result does not generalize to novel, safety-critical or open-ended tasks, and includes no universal rule for which reasoning can be externalized.
reviews.trade_off: Moving capability to the harness lowers inference cost but increases task-specific engineering, routing state, maintenance burden and hidden coupling between scaffold and evaluator.

reviews.claim: An incrementally updated scene representation can be the shared state joining perception and reactive control, rather than a visualization-only output.
reviews.mechanism: RGB-D streams update a Gaussian scene with voxel filtering and relocation; the representation yields continuous distance fields consumed by motion planning and reactive collision avoidance.
reviews.artifact_boundary: No event-time implementation commit is pinned in exact v1.
reviews.proved: Simulation, physical robot and pilot shared-workspace evaluations support the proposed perception-control coupling in the tested scenes.
reviews.not_proved: Large environments, broader tasks and grasped-object collision are not established; sphere approximations discard Gaussian uncertainty structure.
reviews.trade_off: A unified mutable state reduces handoff latency but adds tuning, approximate geometry, sensor-calibration dependence and state-consistency obligations.
